summary: Correction recorded 2026-08-03: this receipt promoted the slice too early. Human review found that Personas were not discoverable from the main surface, the application had replaced the supplied names and prompts with abstract lens seeds, and chat-fragment replacement lost the transcript viewport.
Replaced the special-purpose four-card Consult surface with versioned conversation-backed Personas, ordered Persona groups in Settings, and ordinary-composer @mentions.

Added transactional immutable snapshots for live-chat and Persona targets, concurrent ordered dispatch, per-target cancellation, attributed host-only responses, and explicit synthesis from completed peers.
Added additive idempotent migration from legacy Consult panels while retaining hidden recovery commands until converted Personas and groups are verified.
Made Persona versions and invocation snapshots immutable encrypted records; transcript or profile edits increment the Persona version and invalidate older cache ownership.
Routed every Persona profile through the bounded resident-model registry without silent eviction and added a conservative model, projector, context, and backend memory reservation.

Preserved the three cache tiers: bounded memory LRU, encrypted persistent state, and session checkpoints. Exact fresh-process Persona reuse passed; a Persona revision forced ordinary generation with a different cache identity.

Moved Personas and Consult groups into Settings, added the compact group picker and @ autocomplete to the normal composer, removed the legacy dashboard, and rendered responses as ordinary attributed chat messages.

Built and launched the macOS app with the upstream llama.cpp logo, then exercised freezing, autocomplete, group dispatch, single-target cancellation, synthesis, edit cancellation, and relaunch persistence in the native window.

tests_run.detail: 39 runtime unit tests, 24 deterministic runtime integration tests, 10 deterministic CLI tests, cache, engine, evidence, and readiness suites passed. Real-model tests remain ignored by default and were run explicitly below.
Four native-view tests passed, including command metadata and no-Consult-dashboard assertions.
Inference remains in-process; MCP is the sole bounded process adapter.
81 commands, 90 affordances, 25 effects, 36 parity rows, 58 upstream settings, and zero blockers.
First use generated a cache, the exact Persona version reused it, and version 2 rejected it and generated a distinct cache entry.
Four targets started, one was cancelled independently, at least two peers completed, synthesis used completed peers, and source chats and Persona templates were unchanged.
A second distinct profile was rejected before load with resident_model_memory_budget_exceeded; the resident model remained loaded.
Encrypted sequence state restored in a fresh process with an empty memory tier; automatic session checkpoint reuse also passed.
Exact Persona cache ID survived a fresh process; editing to version 2 forced a new cache ID and ordinary generation.

tests_run.command: native desktop acceptance through the bundled app
tests_run.detail: This verified mechanics but omitted the clean first-run task of finding a Persona and starting its chat, did not compare the seed catalog to the supplied source file, and did not test transcript viewport continuity. Receipt 016 replaces this product-readiness claim.

findings: Saved Personas were buried in Settings and absent from primary navigation.
The application seeded abstract lens labels and shortened prompts instead of the exact supplied Persona catalog.
Whole-chat fragment swaps discarded the transcript viewport after a completed message.

storage_and_permission_boundary.store: encrypted SQLite WAL using one installation key
storage_and_permission_boundary.visual_acceptance_key_source: one explicit isolated acceptance key; production Keychain data was not touched

cache_boundary.memory: bounded LRU with exact owner and runtime fingerprint
cache_boundary.persistent: authenticated encrypted state with capacity and corruption fail-closed behavior
cache_boundary.session: automatic checkpoint reusable after a fresh process
cache_boundary.persona_identity: Persona ID, immutable version, source snapshot, model, binding/build, tokenizer, template, projector, system prompt, tools, and profile
